Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
hi !
what happens if ....
-i play a Gangrel deevolution on a vampire, which later becomes a ahrimane ?
does he gains his bleed ability back ? Do all clan hosers lose effect when a
clan impersonation is around ? which are those who stay permanently on the
vampire ?

-i am playing a brujah deck . My predator plays spirit marionette on, say,
Anvil. Anvil bleeds me but i play Brujah frenzy ? the action is blocked but
is it finished ? who is the controller of the brujah at this time ? and can
i choose one of my own minion to fight the marionnette ?

reyda

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <9vjli0$gfp$1...@neon.noos.net>, Reyda <re...@noos.fr> writes:
>-i play a Gangrel deevolution on a vampire, which later becomes a ahrimane ?

When in play, it's a "that vampire" effect, not a "that Gangrel" or
"this Gangrel". So changing clans won't help.

>Do all clan hosers lose effect when a
>clan impersonation is around ?

It depends on the wording. If they constantly check (e.g. "The <Clan
name> with this vampire gets...") then yes.

>-i am playing a brujah deck . My predator plays spirit marionette on, say,
>Anvil. Anvil bleeds me but i play Brujah frenzy ?

Sure.

>the action is blocked but
>is it finished ?

No. The block and block combat are part of the action.

>who is the controller of the brujah at this time ?

The person who stole it.

>and can
>i choose one of my own minion to fight the marionnette ?

Sure; they (the stolen vampire and your minion) don't have the same
controller.
